name: swarm
purpose: Fan out N workers over slices, identical race briefs or a mixture, then return one evidenced report.
inputs: Done predicate, required artifacts, N and partition slices or race arms
Exact full revisions, measurement method, race selection rule and authorized outputs
outputs: Consolidated in-chat result table and evidenced issue one-liners
Explicit gaps, dropouts, race rule and capability limits
ordinaryExample: Use /swarm to cover separate repository slices at an exact commit; reject a result missing its sampling method, retry it once and report any remaining coverage gap.
capabilityLimits: Full behavior needs authorized independent spawn, wait and result inspection
Sequential fallback is reduced capability and does not establish race parity
Cloud/background execution, base-branch selection and exact models require observed host support
Cancellation requires observed stop, terminal inspection and artifact quarantine
